200.description:

| `faction_only` | string | alliance or horde when the Group Finder offers it to one faction only. |

| `players_classic_era` | number | Classic Era group size when Forever changed it. |

| `revealed_at_launch` | boolean | True when the instance is sealed in the beta files and opens at launch. |

200.description:
One World of Warcraft: Forever class spec on one page: what each stat is worth (stat values at level 60), the racials that raise a stat the spec values, the site's calculated pre-raid best in slot at level 60 with item ids and sources, the best flask, elixirs, food and scroll, and the class's crafted Tier 1 set with bonuses.

The response contains the tool result directly.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `class` | string |  |
| `consumables` | object[] | Best flask, elixirs, food and scroll for the stats the spec values, with their tooltip text. |
| `data_build` | string | Game client build the site's data comes from, as its footer states. |
| `observed_at_ms` | number | Unix time in milliseconds when this program read the source. |
| `pre_raid_bis` | object[] | The site's calculated pre-raid best in slot at level 60 in PvE: one pick per slot. |
| `racials` | object[] | Racials of this class's races that raise a stat the spec values (empty when none does). |
| `role` | string | Role the site gives the spec: Damage, Tank or Healer. |
| `spec` | string |  |
| `stat_weights` | object[] | Value of one point of each stat for the spec in PvE, highest first. Estimates the site's best-in-slot lists are scored with. |
| `stat_weights_level` | number | Character level the stat values are for (60 on every spec page). |
| `stat_weights_note` | string | The site's note on the unit of the values (for example attack power = 1) and where they come from. |
| `tier1` | object | The class's crafted Tier 1 set for the spec: pieces with slots and set bonuses; null when the page has none. |
| `title` | string | Page heading, like `Arms Warrior`. |
| `url` | string | Forever Codex page read. |


These are the provider's documented fields. Field requiredness, nullability and nested object structures are specified only where the descriptions explicitly say so.
